title: Table
description: The admin staple — a quiet header, hairline rows, and a Badge for status.
usage: Left-align text, right-align numbers with .num on the th and td (end-aligned, tabular digits). Keep row actions at the far right. Put the header row in <thead> with scope="col".
a11y: Real <table> with a <thead> of scope="col" headers so screen readers can navigate by row and column. The scrolling wrapper is a named region with tabindex="0", so keyboard users can scroll a table wider than the screen with the arrow keys; give each region its own aria-label. Avatar initials are aria-hidden so the owner cell reads as the name. Header text (ink-3 on bg-soft) measures 4.51:1 light and 4.71:1 dark. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
